description: This file defines the class `CalendarAccountRelationshipManager`, which manages relationships between calendar events (such as Meetings, Calls, Tasks) and calendar accounts within the SuiteCRM platform. It provides methods for creating, updating, retrieving, and enforcing constraints on these relationships, including upserting relationships, updating fields, fetching relationship data, and ensuring a one-to-many association between events and calendar accounts.

classes.name: CalendarAccountRelationshipManager
classes.description: This class manages the relationships between calendar events and calendar accounts, including creating, updating, retrieving data, and enforcing constraints on these relationships within the SuiteCRM platform.

methods.name: upsertEventCalendarAccountRelationship
methods.description: Creates or updates the relationship between an event (Meeting, Call, Task) and a calendar account, inserting or updating records in the relationship table.

methods.name: updateRelationshipFields
methods.description: Updates specific fields in the relationship middle table for a given calendar account and event.

methods.name: getRelationshipData
methods.description: Retrieves relationship data such as external event ID, last sync time, and source for a given event and calendar account.

methods.name: ensureUniqueCalendarAccount
methods.description: Ensures that each event is associated with only one calendar account by removing other relationships if necessary.
